text:
The plate holds scrambled eggs and what look like fried cassava or yuca pieces (possibly fried plantain or polenta).

Scrambled eggs: about 2 eggs, roughly 100 g, at about 150 kcal.

Fried yellow pieces: 5 pieces, roughly 15–20 g each, so about 85 g. If they are fried yuca at about 2 kcal/g, that is about 170 kcal. If they are pineapple, they would be far lower, but the matte, slightly crisp look suggests fried yuca.

Total: about 185 g and about 320 kcal.
